facts.statement: A community event called Robgoblin Rave was held at the Robgoblin Camp north of the Lakeshore Warpstone, with music, dancing and fun.
facts.quote: Our next community event will be at the Robgoblin Camp north of the Lakeshore Warpstone.

facts.statement: The U.S. and Latin America session of the Robgoblin Rave was on Thursday January 13th, 2011 at 3pm Pacific Time, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday January 13th, 2011 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session of the Robgoblin Rave was on Friday January 14th, 2011 at 9:00am Pacific Time / 6:00pm GMT, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday January 14th, 2011 9:00am Pacific Time / 6:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

facts.statement: Players were encouraged to wear Wizard robes to the Robgoblin Rave, and the event expected spell effects.
facts.quote: If you have Wizard robes this is the party where you will want to wear them!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Robgoblin Rave)
article_summaries.summary: A community event announcement for a party ('Robgoblin Rave') held at the Robgoblin Camp north of the Lakeshore Warpstone, with music, dancing and spells, and Wizard robes encouraged. It gives two server-1 time slots, one for the U.S./Latin America and one for UK/Europe. The page is dated only as 'Posted 6 days, 8 hours ago' relative to the capture, so the posting date is inferred from the capture (about January 2011) rather than stated.
